title: TiEBe: Tracking Language Model Recall of Notable Worldwide Events Through Time

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing LLM factual recall accuracy on notable historical events across 23 different countries and regions to identify geographic performance disparities.

Calculating Pearson and Spearman correlations between model accuracy on country-specific events and country-level socioeconomic indicators such as GDP, Human Development Index (HDI), and Mean Years of Schooling (MYS).

Comparing model factual recall accuracy when questions are presented in English versus the native languages of the event regions, specifically highlighting performance degradation in low-resource languages.
